definitions.explanation: A document listing goods or services provided and requesting payment.

examples.japanese: {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Verify the amount on the invoice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The invoice arrives at the end of the month.

notes:
{請求書|せいきゅうしょ} is a compound: ⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧ (billing/claim) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ} (invoice - request for payment)
- ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧ (receipt - proof of payment received)
- ⟦{見積書|みつもりしょ}→見積書：07484_mitsumorisho⟧ (estimate/quote)
- ⟦{納品書|のうひんしょ}→納品書：06594_nouhinsho⟧ (delivery slip)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send an invoice)
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧ (to issue an invoice)
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay an invoice)
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧ (payment by invoice)

MODERN USAGE:
⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{請求書|せいきゅうしょ} (electronic invoice) is becoming more common in business.
